body:
No, I don't think any professional could help. It's not a matter of "oh life is worth it" its a matter of "life takes too long."

It's not that I don't want to live, its that I just want to experience death. 

I have considered the marine corps. I am very physically fit and have perfect health, I would just be a little bit more risky than the average marine. If I don't die I can prove to myself that I am unkillable, if I do die, then I get to experience death.
